chapters.label: Biiyond Production Pvt. Ltd.
chapters.title: We build the kind of company we wanted to work at.
chapters.alt: A single thin line of light across darkness.

chapters.label: [01] Where we are
chapters.title: Made in Nepal.
body: We started during lockdown, with one laptop and an account on a freelance marketplace. We are still here.
Nepal is not a discount. It is where the people we trust happen to live. What we ship goes out at the standard the world expects.
chapters.alt: First light touching a single Himalayan summit above dark valleys.

chapters.label: [02] The whole idea
chapters.title: Almost everything good is made by a small group of people who cared more than they had to.
body: That is the whole idea. Find those people. Give them room, and something solid to stand on. Then let them build.
Today that is a studio and a school. We are not in a hurry to be big. We are in a hurry to be good.
chapters.alt: Above a sea of clouds at dawn; one line of light runs along the horizon.

tree.label: Two, so far
tree.note: Two branches today. The rest are drawn and waiting.

careersCta.title: If you make things, we should talk.
careersCta.body: Editors, producers, designers, and people who are good at running things. We care more about how you think, and whether you finish, than where you studied.

header.label: How we think
header.title: Not a mission statement.
header.body: Just the things we have found to be true so far.

beliefsA.title: People first, then systems, then scale.
beliefsA.body: Most companies do this backwards and wonder why nothing holds. We hire slowly, write down how the work is done, and only then grow.

beliefsA.title: Craft is not a luxury.
beliefsA.body: "Good enough" is a decision to be forgettable. The extra hour on the edit is the difference between a company people come back to and one they replace.

beliefsA.title: Reliability is a creative act.
beliefsA.body: Anyone can be brilliant occasionally. Being good every time, on the date you promised, is much rarer. We would rather be trusted than admired.

beliefsB.title: We build assets, not income.
beliefsB.body: Money that arrives this month is useful. Something that keeps producing after you stop pushing it is worth far more. Every decision here is judged on which one it is.

beliefsB.title: Teach what you know.
beliefsB.body: A skill that lives in one person is fragile. A skill written down and taught to ten people is a company. That is why we built a school.

beliefsB.title: Nobody should have to guess.
beliefsB.body: What the work is, how it is judged, and what the next step takes — all of it is written down, and anyone here can read it.

beliefsB.title: Stay close to the ground.
beliefsB.body: We are in Kathmandu. The work goes out to the world. Nothing about that is a disadvantage as long as the work is honest and the communication is clear.

vipassana._readme: HELD DELIBERATELY. Do not set show:true until the policy has been announced inside the company.
vipassana.title: Ten days, paid, to sit still.
vipassana.body: Anyone here, in any role, can take ten days of paid leave to sit a Vipassana course. Bring the confirmation email. That is the whole process.

twoKinds.label: Where this goes
twoKinds.title: There are two kinds of work.

k1.title: Work for other people
k1.body: Stops paying the day you stop doing it.

k2.title: Work we own
k2.body: Keeps paying after everyone has gone home.

twoKinds.left: Leafcut is the first kind. It is a good business, it is the one we are best at, and it pays for everything else here.
right: The second kind is what we are building next. Small teams, three or four people, something with our own name on it that we keep.
We will start when there is somebody worth handing it to. That is the only condition.

closer.title: We build the kind of company we wanted to work at.
closer.body: Everything above is only what that means in practice.

header.label: Work with us
header.title: We are almost always short of good people.
header.body: A small company in Nepal that makes video for the world, and teaches people how to do it.

like.label: What it is like here
like.title: We are direct about work and kind about people.
body: The clients are on the other side of the world, the deadlines are actual deadlines, and the review before anything ships is a real one.
We say what needs fixing, quickly, and then we fix it. Nobody here has to guess what their manager thinks.
We hire for the long term, which means we are slow to make offers and slow to let people go.

look.label: What we look for

rows.title: Honesty first.
rows.body: Everything else can be taught. This cannot.

rows.title: People who finish.
rows.body: Starting is common. Finishing — properly, on time, at standard — is rare, and it is the whole job.

rows.title: Curiosity.
rows.body: Our tools change every few months. The people who do well here find that exciting rather than exhausting.

rows.title: Comfort with systems.
rows.body: We write things down and we follow them. If process feels like a cage to you, this is the wrong company.

look.note: We care very little about which college you attended.

grow.label: How you grow here
grow.title: Every role has a next step, and the next step is written down.
body: Each track has levels. Each level says what you must be able to do, and what it takes to reach the one above it. Salary sits in a band attached to the level.
Reviewed twice a year, on fixed dates, against those criteria — not against how loudly anyone asks.
grow.note: Drag or scroll · five tracks · reviewed twice a year

closer.title: We are hiring editors.
body: And producers, project managers, designers, and people who are good at running things. If you are good at any of it, write to us — we would rather meet you early than advertise late.
Send your work and a short note. What you have made, and what you would like to make next. A portfolio matters more than a CV.
closer.after: Every application gets read. We reply either way.

header.label: For investors
header.title: How we think about capital.
header.body: Biiyond is owner-operated and funded from what it earns. This page exists for the conversations that come later.

structure.label: The structure
structure.title: One company, two brands, no outside shareholders.
body: Biiyond Production Pvt. Ltd. is a private limited company registered in Kathmandu. Leafcut is a trading brand of it, not a separate entity.
The company is held by its founders. There is no outside capital on the register today, and no debt against the operating business.

rows.title: We allocate, we do not operate.
rows.body: The job is deciding where the next rupee goes, not running the floor. Every business we own has one named owner who holds a number.

rows.title: Assets before income.
rows.body: Money that arrives this month is useful. Something that keeps producing after you stop pushing it is worth far more. Every decision is judged on which one it is.

rows.title: Hiring is gated on revenue already earned.
rows.body: No appointment is made against a forecast. Each phase unlocks only once the revenue that pays for it has arrived and held.

rows.title: Slow on purpose.
rows.body: We would rather own two good businesses than six average ones, and we will wait for the right person rather than fill a seat.

partner.title: What we would want from a partner.
body: Patience, and somebody who has built something in a market like this one. Capital alone is not the constraint — the next twelve months are funded.
We are looking for a person we would still want on the register in ten years.

closer.title: We are not raising today.
closer.body: The current plan is funded by the company and its shareholders. When that changes, the financials, the register and the contracts will sit in a data room — not on a website — and this page will say so.
closer.disclaimer: Nothing on this page is an offer of securities or an invitation to invest.
